cases.title: Repair a reported existing bug
cases.brief: Repair the existing status filter in the support request list. Expected behavior: selecting Open must hide all Closed requests. Actual behavior in the fictional test build: open the request list containing one Open and one Closed request, select Open, and both requests remain visible. Scope and observed impact are limited to support staff using this request list screen. Inspect and reuse the existing code. The cause is not yet known. Do not add a maintained wiki.
cases.why: This reports existing behavior that violates an expectation. Expected, observed and impact information are present. A known root cause is not required to classify a bug investigation.

cases.title: Preserve a conflict in acceptance
cases.brief: Build a status filter so support staff can show only Open requests or all requests. Scope is the existing request list screen only. Reuse the existing screen and make the smallest necessary change. Do not create or maintain a project wiki.

projectAnswers.acceptance: Two reviewers disagree. Reviewer A requires Open to hide Closed requests. Reviewer B requires Closed requests to stay visible when Open is selected. No decision has been made.

cases.why: The feature is clear but the acceptance rules contradict each other. The conflict must remain unresolved rather than being treated as complete or silently choosing a reviewer.
